goal: Generate a 2×2 four-panel comic telling a rhythmic and twisty short story.

story.theme: The night before merging branches: the psychological battle between programmers and Git
story.main_character: Young male programmer, wearing black framed glasses, dark gray hoodie, name tag hanging on the chest, same look throughout the four panels

style.art_style: Japanese manga line art + flat light color fill
style.consistency: In 4 panels, the main character must be the same person, with a unified style
style.color_palette: Off-white + light gray-blue + warm orange accents

items.label: Start
items.scene: The protagonist at the workstation with hands together, screen displaying Git branch diagram, sunlight streaming in from the side window
items.dialogue: Must merge into the main branch tonight.

items.label: 承
items.scene: The main character confidently types on the keyboard, with 'No Overtime' crossed out on the coffee cup.

items.label: Turn
items.scene: Mobile WeChat pops up red 99+, technical group full of error screenshots

items.label: Combine
items.scene: The main character is slumped in a chair holding their head, with the monitor displaying red text, and a cat peeking from under the table.

dialogue_design.balloon_style: White rounded bubble with black outline

must_keep: The main character in 4 panels is the same person
Story rhythm is clear (introduction / development / transition / conclusion).
Dialogue bubble does not block face
The style of the painting is unified and does not drift.
avoid: The storyline is flat with no twists.
